review_procedure: Before merging a deferral, the release owner must approve its exact feature ID, rationale, and target release in a QQQ issue comment or PR review. Copy that direct permalink into owner_approval. The reviewer must open the link and confirm the author and matching details; URL format validation alone does not prove approval. Record accepted deferrals in release issue #790 before publishing, and remove each entry once verified.

accepted_next_release.rationale: Maintainer accepts the published NextRC11 browser/parity/visual limitations for coordinated RC1. Full successor certification remains pending; source and public compatibility checks remain required. This does not certify any missing or failed test.
accepted_next_release.target_release: Next 1.0 final; intermediate Next RCs pair with new QQQ4.1 RCs and explicit updated acceptance decisions.

accepted_next_release.rationale: Maintainer waives the Next acceptance-receipt gate for QQQ4.1.0-RC.2, paired with the unchanged published NextRC11 artifact already accepted for RC1 (same source SHA and JAR hash). The QQQ changes since RC1 are framework fixes; the RC11 browser/parity/visual limitations are retained. Full successor certification remains pending; source and public compatibility checks remain required. This does not certify any missing or failed test, a newer Next artifact, or general availability.
accepted_next_release.target_release: Next 1.0.0-RC.12 pairs with a later QQQ4.1 RC under its own receipts or an explicit updated acceptance decision; full certification at Next 1.0 final.

accepted_next_release.rationale: Release owner approved QQQ4.1.0-RC.3 and waives the Next acceptance-receipt gate for it, paired with the unchanged published NextRC11 artifact already accepted for RC1 and RC2 (same source SHA and JAR hash). Full successor certification remains pending; source and public compatibility checks remain required. This does not certify any missing or failed test, a newer Next artifact, or general availability.
